plan.title: Remove Python entrypoints from the consumer Taskfile and tasks surface

narratives.Description: The consumer task surface must invoke only the directive CLI, but several tasks still shell out to python3, uv run, or scripts/*.py. This story audits the Taskfile and tasks files and removes or relocates every Python entrypoint on the consumer deposit path, separating maintainer-only Python tasks behind the contributor path.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Scan Taskfile.yml and the tasks config files for python3, uv run, and scripts/ entrypoints and catalogue each consumer-path offender.
- Rewrite each consumer task to invoke the directive CLI, and move any maintainer-only Python task behind the #1813 contributor path or remove it.
- Verify with a grep test and `task check` that zero Python entrypoints remain on the consumer surface.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer running deft tasks, I want the Taskfile and tasks surface to invoke only the directive CLI, so that no task shells out to Python on my install.

items.title: Given the consumer task surface, when Taskfile.yml and the tasks files are scanned, then no python3, uv run, or scripts/ entrypoint remains on the consumer deposit path.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the consumer task surface, when Taskfile.yml and the tasks files are scanned, then no python3, uv run, or scripts/ entrypoint remains on the consumer deposit path.

items.title: Given a maintainer-only Python task, when the audit runs, then it is moved behind the contributor path or removed.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a maintainer-only Python task, when the audit runs, then it is moved behind the contributor path or removed.

items.title: Given the audited surface, when `task check` runs, then it exits zero with the directive CLI as the only invoked engine.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the audited surface, when `task check` runs, then it exits zero with the directive CLI as the only invoked engine.
